poster.alt: Noise profile extractor field guide: the measurement records a 60 Hz hum but the label reads white hiss so no high-pass is applied

card1.alt: The six-branch classification cascade of the noise profile extractor with five tiles, showing that only the hum and rumble branches add a high-pass

card2.alt: One measurement sweep at minus 55 dBFS of 60 Hz hum over a minus 30 dBFS white bed showing flatness 0.971, low ratio 0.413, a white-hiss label, hum recorded at 60 Hz, and a null high-pass

card3.alt: Four limits of the saved noise profile: a recorded hum with no filter, the stored noise reduction value always 20, the clamped noise floor range, and the unguarded speech risk
